name: metadata-erp
description: Vertical-first industry solutions platform with metadata-driven packs for E-commerce, Automotive, Oil & Gas, AgTech, FinTech, and Insurance/MedTech

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:js" "npm run dev:auth"
scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:auth: cd services/auth && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.dev:files: cd services/files && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8002
scripts.dev:integrations: cd services/integrations && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8003
scripts.dev:ai-support: cd packages/ai-services/ai-support-service && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8004
scripts.dev:voice: cd packages/ai-services/voice-service && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8005
scripts.install:both: npm run install:js ; npm run install:python
scripts.build: npm run build:packages ; npm run build:apps
scripts.dev:full-watch: concurrently "npm run watch:shared-ui" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:auth"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces ; npm run test:python
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js ; npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: poetry run black --check . ; poetry run isort --check-only . ; poetry run flake8 . ; poetry run mypy .
scripts.format: npm run format:js ; npm run format:python
scripts.format:python: poetry run black . ; poetry run isort .
scripts.migrate:theme-variants: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const platform = process.platform; const script = platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.ps1' : 'bash scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.sh'; execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.migrate:theme-variants:verify: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const platform = process.platform; const script = platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.ps1 -Verify' : 'bash scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.sh --verify'; execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.migrate:theme-variants:dry-run: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const platform = process.platform; const script = platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.ps1 -DryRun' : 'bash scripts/migrations/migrate-theme-variants.sh --dry-run'; execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.setup:laptop: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const platform = process.platform; const script = platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup/laptop_setup.ps1' : 'bash scripts/setup/laptop_setup.sh'; execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.verify:setup: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const platform = process.platform; const script = platform === 'win32' ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/quick-verify.ps1' : 'bash scripts/quick-verify.sh'; execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.db:seed: cd services/api && poetry run python data/seed-scripts/seed_all.py
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd services/api && poetry run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed

author: Alkas Software
